recommendation: Do not deploy an allocation rule from the observed adjusted associations.
identification: Hidden U leaves total effect unidentified from observed X,G. Oracle access is simulation-only.
fairness: Inspect access and outcomes by relevant groups; synthetic G provides no evidence of real demographic performance. Do not turn the simulated group contrast into an exclusion rule.
cost: 2.8 synthetic score-equivalent units is a teaching assumption, not an observed economic utility.
appeal: Any prospective pilot needs a documented human reconsideration route, explanation of decisions and correction of data errors.
stop_conditions: evidence of harm or unequal access
poor overlap or unstable subgroup estimates
negative-control evidence inconsistent with identification assumptions
intervention differs from the stated treatment
next_evidence: An ethically reviewed randomized or otherwise credibly identified prospective study, with explicit consent and monitoring.
